seedPolicy: Future create operation generates128-bit cryptographic seed once; persist lowercase32-hex seed with selection metadata. Not executed in this preparation.
rankingProtocol:
For each eligible form, rankHash=SHA256(UTF8("DIAGFORM/v1
"+bankDigest+"
"+eligibilityDigest+"
"+seedHex+"
"+formId)). Choose lexically lowest lowercase hash; tie-break by ASCII formId. This is a written proposal, not an implementation.
eligibleFormRule: All domain/skill quotas met; all29 content/rights approvals; all27 keys approved; required final audio exists, hash matches, human alignment and rights signed. Failure means NO_ELIGIBLE_FORM, never relax quotas or add unreviewed items.
eligibilitySnapshot: Persist sorted eligible form IDs, reviewed item/key/media revision IDs and digest of that eligibility state; do not replay against current approvals.
resumePolicy: Read saved assignment and exact snapshot/order; never generate a seed or reselect on refresh, skip, resume, save/retry or submit.
retakePolicy: Explicit owner-approved retake creates new attemptId,assignmentId,seed and eligibility snapshot; preserve prior immutable attempt. Prefer unused form if approved by a separately versioned exposure policy; current proposal does not implement that preference.
sameSeedLimit: Replay requires same algorithm, bank/approval digests, eligible forms and seed; seed alone is insufficient.
ownership: Local learner scope is development-only, not secure authorization; future API derives owner from authenticated session.
apiReplacement: API adapter returns same versioned public DTOs/snapshots; server retains keys. No endpoints, selection code or frontend changes created.
